operations.title: Entry 654 — The Pre-Residue Top Line Is Not the Wall-Syzygy Target

operations.title: A direct three-to-one map from minimal wall syzygies to the pre-residue top line is mistyped
operations.statement: The pre-residue top line lives in a three-variable q_g1,q_g2,q_G12 complex, whereas the syzygies live after q_G12 residue on a two-variable five-wall surface. Their legal first target is the rank-six shared-wall localization quotient.

operations.title: Construct the retained-presentation Poincare residue and wall-localization map
operations.question: Does the pre-residue physical source map to Entry 648's wall cocycle, and what is the image rank of the three minimal syzygies in that common rank-six target?

authority_basis.summary: Operator directed continuation; Entry 654 and its type gate separate the pre-residue top line from the residue-surface syzygy target.
